fullSource:
use default

let heading = (1::12) |> map(column => "{column,4}") |> join("")

write_line("  x{heading}")
write_line("")

for row in 1::12 do
    let cells =
        (1::12)
            |> map(column =>
                if column < row then "    " else "{row * column,4}" fi)
            |> join("")

    write_line("{row,3}{cells}")
od
